narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -3.32 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 0.2096-0.2105 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip), where the footprint printed its confirmation. Risk is defined beyond 0.2127; the first objective pays 1.81R at 0.2086.

plan.triggerRule: footprint exh fired sell in short direction at the zone
plan.invalidation: structure beyond 0.2127 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)
vetoes: M1 A/A+ demoted: no positive-delta absorption or CVD divergence at the pullback zone

athena_oracle.verdict: Strong bearish confluence 27/100 — trend broken, liq magnets below, whales offering

factors.name: Liquidation Gravity
factors.detail: long liq $688k -1.7% below · short liq $271k +3.1% above

funding: venues missing from the OI chart were weighted at the mean OI of matched venues
funding rates are percent per interval; annualizedAprPct = oiWeightedRate8h(%) x 3 x 365
fundingImpliedAprPct is the funding-implied carry (oiWeightedRate8h annualized) — NOT a basis APR
